scripts.setup: NUXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run prepare && go -C apps/api mod download
scripts.openapi:lint: pnpm exec redocly lint --config redocly.yaml apps/api/api/openapi/operational.yaml
scripts.openapi:bundle: pnpm exec redocly bundle --config redocly.yaml apps/api/api/openapi/operational.yaml -o .openapi/operational.yaml
scripts.openapi:html: pnpm exec redocly build-docs --config redocly.yaml apps/api/api/openapi/operational.yaml --disableGoogleFont -o .openapi/operational.html
scripts.openapi: pnpm run openapi:lint && pnpm run openapi:bundle && pnpm run openapi:html
scripts.test:browser: node scripts/build-web.mjs test && pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.format: pnpm run api:format && pnpm run web:lint:fix
scripts.format:check: pnpm run api:format:check && pnpm run web:lint
scripts.lint: pnpm run api:lint && pnpm run web:lint && pnpm run openapi:lint
scripts.test: pnpm run api:test && pnpm run web:test
scripts.build: pnpm run api:build && pnpm run web:build
scripts.audit: pnpm run node:audit && pnpm run api:vuln
scripts.check:fast: pnpm run api:format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.check: pnpm run check:fast && pnpm run test:race && pnpm run build && pnpm run openapi && pnpm run audit && pnpm run test:browser
